title: Mean from sign probabilities
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$. Its mean equals the uniform probability that its value is $+1$ minus the uniform probability that its value is $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
